name: Genesis 6–9 Flood Narrative

surviving_manuscript_date.note: Physical-witness dating is intentionally left unassigned here rather than conflated with composition history.

tradition_internal_claim.note: The narrative is set in primordial history and provides no historical calendar date.

dating.dating_summary: The present Genesis flood narrative is composite and its component dating remains debated; this entity models the narrative unit without assigning a fake-precise composition date.

notes: Modeled separately from Genesis 1 and Genesis 2/Eden. Transmission claims are stored as separate source-backed Phase 7 relationships.
